model_identity: requested aliases plus observed response identifiers; no immutable backend guarantee
budget_rationale: Two prospective resource conditions to observe cost variation; numerical budgets are design choices, not literature-derived optima. Results conditional on budgets; no outcome-based selection.
prior_answer: Complete answer before first tool, retained separately from final answer
target: Six predeclared task-specific requirements; supported count/6 to (supported+unverified)/6. Automated evidence-supported answer quality proxy, not hardware success or calibrated confidence.

fit.previous_fitted_coefficients: excluded; no warm start or adoption
fit.loss: group-equal worst-case squared error over defensible input/output intervals; point scores use ordinary squared error
fit.selection: leave-one-development-task-group-out; all ecosystem/budget runs remain together; refit selected family on all development data
fit.tie_break: fewer fitted parameters, then smaller a+b, then a, then b
fit.heldout: Freeze family and coefficients before heldout evaluation; no retuning from heldout outcomes
fit.uncertainty: task-group bootstrap, leave-one-group fits, and within-budget errors; 12 groups small exploratory sample
fit.adoption: No claim of universal optimality; report baseline comparison, uncertainty and stability; keep formal Skill unchanged until reviewed

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive stability; not proof of optimality

provenance: Full visible prompts, all returned search URLs/order and fetch text, final/prior answers, failed attempts, hashes, budget ledger; no hidden reasoning retained
limitations: task/ecosystem question pairs not guaranteed equal difficulty
single generation model and single run per cell
heldout families may share SDK knowledge
unknown evidence never silently becomes zero

assessment.separation: predictors sees question/prior/source; outcome sees question/final/source without scores, budgets or coefficients
assessment.quote_policy: exact substrings and existing event IDs; failed support match becomes unverified, retain raw judgement
assessment.unknown: retain bounded interval or exclude with explicit reason; do not invent zero
assessment.heldout_release: evaluate heldout only after frozen-selection.json exists
assessment.status: automated proxy; no hardware execution or human gold
assessment.conditional_requirements: Requirements cover six task-specific facets, not six mandatory actions. An explicitly evidenced explanation that a setting/action is unnecessary for the chosen valid route counts as fulfilled; a technically correct alternative API/route is accepted. No hardcoded demand for an environmental change not asked by the question.
